external_collaboration.evidence_quote: International courses already exist in state secondary schools in the Central Pole, but this is not yet the case in the South Pole. However, the structural development of the economy in the south of the country and the establishment of the University of Luxembourg in Belval are generating increased demand for children to attend international classes. High-quality schooling is an important factor in the decision of companies, foreign investors and scientific experts as to whether or not to settle
